BiblicalUsage: Nohah is the fourth son of Benjamin, named in the genealogy of 1 Chronicles 8:2 beside his brothers Bela, Ashbel, Aharah, and Rapha. He has no story of his own in Scripture, only a place in the family line of Benjamin.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God keeps the names of people the world forgets, and a place in the genealogy is itself a kind of honour.
